summary: Iteration 5 — Category Management feature ALL PASS. Backend: 11/11 new pytest cases green in /app/backend/tests/test_categories.py. GET /api/categories (no auth) returns 3 defaults sorted by order with {id,name,slug,order,isActive}; no ObjectId leaked. GET /api/admin/categories requires admin bearer (401 without) and marks defaults with isDefault=true. POST creates 'Music' → slug='music', isDefault=false, order=20, isActive=true. Duplicate POST {'name':'music'} → 409. PUT rename 'Music'→'Live Music' → slug becomes 'live-music' (cascade rename applied to shows.category as well per server.py:1355-1357). DELETE unreferenced category → {'ok':true}. DELETE vod (referenced by seeded shows) → 409 with 'Cannot delete: N show(s) still use this category'. Final listing still contains defaults. Frontend (mobile 390x844, admin phone +250798875272 OTP 123456): (1) home-admin badge visible only for admin role user; (2) Admin Console shows FOUR cards including the new 'Categories' card [data-testid=admin-card-categories, icon pricetags-outline]; (3) categories.tsx list shows VOD/Podcast/Interview with 'default' tag + edit/eye/trash icons + slug caption; (4) categories-add opens new-category form, entering name 'Sports News' + CREATE CATEGORY → new row 'Sports News · slug: sports-news' appears at bottom; (5) edit-cat-sports-news → change order to 5 → SAVE → returns to list; (6) admin/shows > shows-add-toggle opens new-show-form; category chip row rendered dynamically from /api/categories — chips 'VOD', 'PODCAST', 'INTERVIEW', 'SPORTS TALK' present (previously hardcoded, now dynamic ✅); (7) Public /(tabs)/shows chip row renders 'All' + dynamic categories: chip-all, chip-vod, chip-podcast, chip-interview, chip-sports-talk all present with data-testid — proves API-driven filtering.

ui_bugs.issue: Alert.alert('Delete category?', ...) from RN Web renders as an in-page overlay whose Delete button did not respond to Playwright role-based click. Delete works on native mobile (Alert.alert is native), but on web preview the confirm button may not fire. Non-blocking for iOS/Android; may want a custom Modal for web parity. Reference: /app/frontend/app/admin/categories.tsx:64-80.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1289-1375 categories CRUD is clean: pydantic CategoryIn with defaults, _slugify + duplicate slug guard on both POST/PUT, cascade shows.update_many on slug change, ObjectId excluded via {'_id':0} projection, 409 on referenced deletion — all correct.
server.py:1385-1402 seed() is idempotent per default category (find_one before insert). Good.

admin/categories.tsx cleanly separates list + edit modes, uses api() wrapper with auth:true, has proper testIDs on every interactive control (categories-add, categories-back, edit-cat-*, delete-cat-*, toggle-cat-*, cat-name, cat-order, cat-toggle-active, cat-save).
(tabs)/shows.tsx:31-46 correctly builds `chips` = [{key:'all',label:'All'}, ...cats] via useMemo; testID pattern chip-${slug} works.
admin/shows.tsx:31-33 defensively snaps form.category to first available slug if current selection isn't returned by API (prevents orphaned selection when category is deleted).
